title: IMPOSSIBLE to clean. So many crevices!
text:
IMPOSSIBLE to clean. So many crevices!. Look, the thing toasts sandwiches fine. But after you use it once with real cheese, it is literally easier to buy a new one than to clean this one.

It has so many crevices to trap food! Between the griddle plate and the frame, in the hinge in the lid, under where the cord goes, the coil around the wire between the halves.....
And if you melt any real cheese, the oils drip and you have disaster. And if your sandwich has tuna or tomatoes, well even more mess.

Non-stick isn't great. At least on the edges. You can't soak it in the sink and can't scrape it with metal obviously.

I would use it multiple times a week if it weren't easier to make a 5 course meal than clean this thing. My old one cleaned up in a snap. The designers of this one need to be taken behind the proverbial wood shed and punished. Or a real wood shed! It's that bad.

product_metadata.title: Cuisinart WM-SW2N1 Sandwich Grill, Silver
features: Cooks 2 sandwiches, omelets or servings of French toast
Lock-down lid positions with food on plates to evenly brown both sides
Raised ridges in cooking plates seal edges of bread or omelets to keep ingredients inside and divide sandwiches and updated plate design to reduce overflow
Nonstick baking plates wipe clean in seconds and includes cord storage
description: The Cuisinart Sandwich Maker does more than lunch. This versatile Cuisinart product also makes omelets and French toast! Designed to cook two servings at a time, it is perfect for breakfast, lunch, or light dinners. Dual indicator lights ensure nothing over- or under-cooks, and nonstick plates makes cleanup easy. A lock-down lid guarantees both sides cook evenly, and raised ridges on plates seal in ingredients. When the work is done, the lid lock and cord wrap make storage easy.
